statement_summary: Retrieve, infer and support a reading with references.
Select and combine information from linked sources.
Explain contextual language and structural choices.
Relate writers’ perspectives and how they are conveyed.
Test a judgment using appropriate textual evidence.
Shape clear writing for audience, purpose and form.
Develop and organise ideas coherently for impact.
Control vocabulary, grammar, sentence forms and spelling/punctuation.
Prepare and deliver an effective formal presentation.
Listen and respond to questions and feedback.
Study relevant fiction and non-fiction across19th,20th and21st centuries.
